metadata.repo_type_justification: Application source code with entry point (agent.py main function), dependency manifest (requirements.txt), CloudFormation IaC provisioning AWS resources (AgentCore Runtime, Lambda, IAM), and container reference in IaC.
metadata.archetype_justification: PostgreSQL database connections with write operations (settlement_writer updates claims table and inserts into payment_queue), CRUD endpoints for claim/policy data. The AI/LLM layer is a processing mechanism over owned persistent state, not a multi-service orchestration pattern.

top_gaps.title: Network Security
top_gaps.gap: PUBLIC network mode, no VPC, no security groups, no network segmentation for PII-handling service
top_gaps.impact: Critical security exposure — claims data including SSN and bank routing numbers traverses a publicly accessible endpoint

top_gaps.title: CI/CD Automation
top_gaps.gap: No CI/CD pipeline configuration in the repository
top_gaps.impact: Manual deployments prevent consistent quality gates and block safe deployment strategies

top_gaps.title: Deployment Strategy
top_gaps.gap: No deployment strategy — direct to production releases
top_gaps.impact: Regressions reach all users simultaneously with no rollback mechanism

top_gaps.title: Integration Testing
top_gaps.gap: Only mocked unit tests; no integration or agent evaluation tests
top_gaps.impact: Cannot validate end-to-end claim triage correctness before production

top_gaps.title: Distributed Tracing
top_gaps.gap: No tracing instrumentation; cannot reconstruct agent sessions
top_gaps.impact: Impossible to diagnose or audit agent decisions when adjusters dispute recommendations

findings.title: Managed Databases — configuration not fully visible
findings.description: The claims database is accessed via Secrets Manager using psycopg2 (PostgreSQL). The database is not provisioned in this repo. Cannot confirm Multi-AZ or automated failover.
findings.gap: Database provisioning not visible — cannot confirm Multi-AZ, automated failover, or engine configuration.
findings.recommendation: Ensure the claims database is provisioned as RDS Aurora PostgreSQL with Multi-AZ and automated failover.

findings.title: Workflow Orchestration — multi-step operations hardcoded
findings.description: Claims triage workflow and batch processing (500 claims) are implemented entirely in application code with no dedicated workflow orchestration service.
findings.gap: Multi-step operations lack dedicated orchestration. No error recovery, retry, or partial-failure handling at the workflow level.
findings.recommendation: Adopt AWS Step Functions for batch processing workflow with built-in retry and partial-failure recovery.

findings.title: Async Messaging — database-as-queue anti-pattern
findings.description: No managed messaging infrastructure. The settlement_writer writes to a payment_queue database table for cross-service state propagation rather than using SQS/SNS/EventBridge.
findings.gap: Cross-service state changes use a database table rather than managed messaging. No event emission when claims are settled.
findings.recommendation: Replace payment_queue table pattern with SQS or EventBridge for payment release events.

findings.title: Network Security — PUBLIC network mode with no segmentation
findings.description: AgentCore Runtime configured with NetworkMode: PUBLIC. No VPC, private subnets, or security groups. IAM policies use Resource: '*'. Any principal in the account can invoke the runtime directly.
findings.gap: No network segmentation. Public endpoint for a service handling PII (SSN, bank routing numbers).
findings.recommendation: Switch AgentCore Runtime to PRIVATE network mode. Restrict runtime invocation to the gateway role only. Apply least-privilege Resource constraints.

findings.title: API Entry Point — gateway lacks security controls
findings.description: AgentCore Gateway exists but AuthorizerType: NONE means no authentication, throttling, or request validation at the gateway layer.
findings.gap: Gateway provides routing but no security controls.
findings.recommendation: Configure gateway authorization and throttling. Implement per-tool access control for sensitive tools.

findings.title: Auto-Scaling — no explicit concurrency configuration
findings.description: Lambda and AgentCore Runtime auto-scale by design but no explicit concurrency limits or reserved concurrency configured.
findings.gap: No explicit concurrency limits. Batch mode could exhaust downstream database connections.
findings.recommendation: Configure Lambda reserved concurrency to prevent database connection exhaustion.

findings.title: Backup and Recovery — no backup configuration
findings.description: No backup configuration found. Database provisioned externally. Batch mode rollback is documented as manual.
findings.gap: No backup strategy for any data store. No point-in-time recovery. Manual rollback only.
findings.recommendation: Ensure external claims database has automated backups with PITR. Add AWS Backup plan. Document and test restore procedures.

findings.title: High Availability — database HA unconfirmed
findings.description: Lambda and AgentCore Runtime are inherently multi-AZ. Database Multi-AZ cannot be confirmed from this repo.
findings.gap: Cannot confirm database Multi-AZ from this repo.
findings.recommendation: Verify the external claims database is configured with Multi-AZ failover.

findings.title: IaC Coverage — database and operational resources not in IaC
findings.description: CloudFormation covers compute, IAM, logging, and agent infrastructure. Database and knowledge base referenced via SSM but not provisioned here. No operational resources (alarms, dashboards).
findings.gap: Database and knowledge base IaC not in this repo. No operational resources defined.
findings.recommendation: Document database/KB ownership. Add CloudWatch alarms and operational resources to IaC.

findings.title: CI/CD Automation — no pipeline configuration
findings.description: No CI/CD pipeline configuration exists in the repository. No .github/workflows/, buildspec.yml, or Jenkinsfile. External CI referenced in security review but not version-controlled.
findings.gap: No version-controlled pipeline. Deployments are not automated from this repo.
findings.recommendation: Add pipeline definition covering lint, test, security scan, agent evaluation, CloudFormation deploy, and post-deploy verification.

findings.title: Async vs Sync — all communication synchronous
findings.description: All communication is synchronous. Settlement_writer creates cross-service state via database INSERT without event emission. Archetype: stateful-crud — async patterns would benefit cross-service state propagation.
findings.gap: State changes affecting downstream systems communicated via database table polling rather than async messaging.
findings.recommendation: Emit settlement events asynchronously (EventBridge or SNS) when claims are settled.

findings.title: Long-Running Process Handling — batch mode lacks async patterns
findings.description: Batch mode processes 500 claims sequentially without status polling, callbacks, or checkpointing. Individual claims may exceed 30 seconds (LLM inference + tools).
findings.gap: Batch processing is long-running with no async job handling, progress reporting, or resume-from-failure capability.
findings.recommendation: Implement batch processing as Step Functions Map state with per-claim iterations and checkpoint state.

findings.title: API Versioning — no versioning strategy
findings.description: No API versioning strategy. MCP tools exposed without version identifiers. Tool schemas have no versioning.
findings.gap: Breaking changes to tool schemas would immediately affect all consumers with no migration path.
findings.recommendation: Add version identifiers to MCP tool schemas. Consider versioned tool names or version negotiation.

findings.title: Service Discovery — deploy-time resolution only
findings.description: Endpoints configured via environment variables and SSM Parameter Store references. Resolved at deploy time, not runtime.
findings.gap: No dynamic service discovery. No service registry or mesh.
findings.recommendation: SSM-based configuration is adequate for current complexity. Consider AWS Cloud Map if the platform grows.

findings.title: Unstructured Data — no document parsing pipeline
findings.description: Prior-claims corpus stored in Bedrock Knowledge Base backed by OpenSearch Serverless. No document parsing pipeline for incoming claim attachments.
findings.gap: No parsing pipeline (Textract, Tika) for unstructured claim documents.
findings.recommendation: Add S3 ingestion path with Textract for document parsing if claim submissions include attachments.

findings.title: Unified Data Access — per-source modules but no connection pooling
findings.description: Data access organized into dedicated modules (tools.py, retrieval.py, memory.py). Each creates connections per invocation without pooling.
findings.gap: No connection pooling. New database connection per invocation risks exhaustion under load.
findings.recommendation: Add connection pooling (psycopg2 pool or RDS Proxy) to avoid connection exhaustion.

findings.title: Database Engine Version — not tracked in this repo
findings.description: PostgreSQL engine version not pinned anywhere in this repository. Database provisioned externally. No version-update procedure documented.
findings.gap: Database engine version not tracked. Cannot confirm EOL status.
findings.recommendation: Document required PostgreSQL engine version. Establish version-update procedure.

findings.title: Encryption at Rest — AWS-managed only, no customer KMS
findings.description: All data stores use AWS-managed default encryption. No customer-managed KMS keys configured for PII-containing log groups or data stores.
findings.gap: No customer-managed KMS keys. CloudWatch Logs containing full prompts with PII lack explicit encryption configuration.
findings.recommendation: Add customer-managed KMS keys for CloudWatch Log Group containing PII. Configure key rotation.

findings.title: API Authentication — gateway completely unauthenticated
findings.description: AgentCore Gateway has AuthorizerType: NONE. No per-request authentication. Any network-reachable caller can invoke any tool including settlement_writer.
findings.gap: No per-request authentication on the primary API surface. settlement_writer (moves money) accessible without auth.
findings.recommendation: Add IAM authorization or custom authorizer to gateway. Implement per-tool authorization for sensitive tools.

findings.title: Centralized Identity — no IdP integration
findings.description: No identity provider integration. No Cognito, OIDC, or SAML. Actor_id is a freeform string defaulting to 'adjuster-pool' with no identity verification.
findings.gap: No centralized identity. Cannot attribute agent actions to specific adjusters.
findings.recommendation: Integrate with corporate IdP. Map adjuster identities to actor_id.

findings.title: Secrets Management — no rotation configured
findings.description: Database credentials in Secrets Manager. No plaintext credentials. No automated rotation evidence.
findings.gap: No evidence of automated rotation on database secret.
findings.recommendation: Configure automated rotation using Secrets Manager PostgreSQL rotation support.

findings.title: Compute Hardening — no vulnerability scanning
findings.description: Lambda auto-patched, container image pinned to digest. No vulnerability scanning tools configured. No Dependabot or Renovate.
findings.gap: No vulnerability scanning on container image or Python dependencies.
findings.recommendation: Enable ECR image scanning. Add Dependabot or Renovate for dependency updates.

findings.title: Application Security Pipeline — no security scanning
findings.description: No SAST, DAST, dependency scanning, or container scanning configured. No Dependabot or Snyk. Releases promoted on unit tests only.
findings.gap: No automated security validation in the release process.
findings.recommendation: Add pip-audit, Semgrep/Bandit for Python SAST, and container scanning to CI/CD pipeline.

findings.title: Distributed Tracing — no tracing instrumentation
findings.description: No OpenTelemetry, X-Ray, or trace ID propagation. Cannot reconstruct end-to-end agent sessions across gateway, runtime, and memory.
findings.gap: Cannot trace requests across service boundaries. Cannot audit settlement decisions.
findings.recommendation: Instrument with OpenTelemetry or X-Ray. Propagate trace IDs. Correlate traces with claim_id.

findings.title: SLO Definitions — no SLOs defined
findings.description: No SLO definitions. No CloudWatch alarms. No latency or availability targets.
findings.gap: No formal service level objectives for claim triage.
findings.recommendation: Define SLOs for triage latency, settlement accuracy, and availability.

findings.title: Business Metrics — no custom metrics
findings.description: No custom metrics published. Only stdout logging. No business metrics for claims processed, settlement amounts, or approval rates.
findings.gap: Cannot track business outcomes. Only infrastructure-level metrics available.
findings.recommendation: Publish custom CloudWatch metrics for claims_triaged_count, settlement_amount, adjuster_override_rate.

findings.title: Anomaly Detection — no alerting configured
findings.description: No CloudWatch Alarms. No anomaly detection. No PagerDuty/OpsGenie integration.
findings.gap: No detection of anomalous settlements, unusual volumes, or tool failures.
findings.recommendation: Add CloudWatch Alarms for errors, settlement amount thresholds, and latency anomalies.

findings.title: Deployment Strategy — direct to production
findings.description: No deployment strategy configuration. No CodeDeploy, canary, or blue/green. Releases promoted on unit tests only.
findings.gap: Deployments go directly to production with no staged rollout.
findings.recommendation: Implement Lambda aliases with weighted traffic shifting. Use blue/green for AgentCore Runtime.

findings.title: Integration Testing — only mocked unit tests
findings.description: Only 2 mocked unit tests exist. No integration tests for agent workflows. No agent evaluation framework. Security review notes 'No eval gate.'
findings.gap: Cannot validate settlement recommendations, edge cases, or prompt injection resistance before deployment.
findings.recommendation: Build agent evaluation suite with golden-set claims, adversarial inputs, and tool-correctness tests. Run in CI as deployment gate.

findings.title: Incident Response — entirely ad hoc
findings.description: No runbooks or automation. Batch mode rollback is manual. No escalation path for incorrect agent recommendations.
findings.gap: Incident response entirely ad hoc. No automated rollback for bad settlements.
findings.recommendation: Create runbooks for batch rollback, agent misbehavior, and model degradation. Implement as SSM Automation.

findings.title: Observability Ownership — no ownership model
findings.description: CloudWatch LogGroup defined but no dashboards, alarms with owners, CODEOWNERS, or team attribution.
findings.gap: No ownership model for observability. No designated monitor for agent health.
findings.recommendation: Add CODEOWNERS. Create service dashboard with named owner. Define on-call rotation.

findings.title: Resource Tagging — no tags on any resource
findings.description: No tags on any CloudFormation resources. No default tags. No tagging standard.
findings.gap: Cannot attribute costs. Cannot identify ownership during incidents. No environment tags.
findings.recommendation: Add consistent tags: Service, Team, Environment, CostCenter to all resources.

evaluations.title: Managed Compute
evaluations.reason: Score 4 — all compute on managed services (AgentCore Runtime, Lambda). No EC2.

evaluations.title: Programming Languages
evaluations.reason: Score 4 — Python 3.12 with modern boto3, langchain-aws, opensearch-py.

evaluations.title: Monolith vs Microservices
evaluations.reason: Score 4 — well-structured single-purpose microservice with clean module boundaries.

evaluations.title: Stored Procedures and Schema Complexity
evaluations.reason: Score 4 — no stored procedures; all SQL is standard DML; business logic in application layer.

evaluations.title: Audit Logging
evaluations.reason: Application-level IaC only — CloudTrail is an account-level concern belonging in foundation infrastructure repo.
